its Isha is 18° as a share of the night (0.30 of it) on the nights without 18°; an Isha floor at 0.30 would cost everyone up to 6 min in Birmingham, 9-16 in Manchester and Bradford and 23-28 in Glasgow from May to July

its April Dhuhr alone is 8-10 min after the meridian against about half a minute in every other month (a one-month step; its November and December are congregation times); absorbing it would move everyone's April Dhuhr 3 min later

its spring Asr drifts between the two schools (the Standard time + 23 min falling to 0); the default, the later school, is never early against it, and absorbing it would delay everyone's Standard Asr by up to 24 min in spring

its March Asr is the Standard time + 4-5 min (8 at the month's end), between the two schools; the default, the later school, is never early against it, and absorbing it would delay everyone's Standard Asr in March

its summer Fajr, when its fast begins, is 4-14 min before the sun's lowest point (0.51-0.53 of the night), alone in the survey; an end of eating at 0.535 of the night would take it but empties the Isha window on 1-6 nights a year at every city checked
it keeps its flat summer Fajr two days after the sun reaches 18° again at its point; no clean rule keeps the middle of the night past the sign's return

by design: spec 3.6 caps Maghrib at the most-followed member's (Wifaqul, sunset + 5) where the members spread past 2 min, and only a Maghrib shown at that cap is taken here, by the calendar's minutes past it (any other early Maghrib fails); Glasgow's 11 calendars print sunset + 6-10, Ashton + 7.4, Masjid Ibraheem + 8 and a few others 1-2 more on some days

the threshold night (ruling R72's class): on the night a member's Isha angle (15°, 17° or 18°) is last or first reached, that member's Isha, the latest, lies near the sun's lowest point and the next end of eating, the middle of the night, at or just before it, so Isha has no end (ruling R26); across the UK up to two nights a year at a point, by up to 3 min, from April to August at some latitudes only (UkCautiousTest); at these 62 points in 2026 one night a calendar at most, by up to 2 min, the figures held here
